# Fabsy Traffic Ticket Services

> Fabsy is a traffic ticket agent service for Alberta drivers. Fabsy is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. Representation is available where paid agent representation is permitted.

Fabsy helps drivers dispute Alberta traffic tickets, including speeding, photo radar, red light, distracted driving, careless driving, and stop sign tickets. The service includes ticket review, disclosure review, paperwork, and traffic court representation where permitted.

Representation uses a $488 base representation fee plus 30% of any fine reduction achieved; there is no success fee if the fine is not reduced. Results vary, and past performance does not predict future outcomes.
